verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions downloadable forms or instructions on edd.ca.gov. The only no-account item is making a payroll tax payment without enrollment (docs-17), which is a different capability. Printing returns (docs-2) is listed as an e-Services account feature, not a public form download, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
